d: Lunar and Martian bases in Ronald D. Moore’s alternate-history space race.

moon.x: Permanent lunar research and water-mining installations established by NASA and the Soviet space program at the lunar south pole.

mars.x: First permanent Martian research colony founded in 1995 during the competitive tri-party expedition between NASA, Helios, and the USSR.

b.s: Alternate-history television drama imagining an unyielding global space race after the Soviet Union achieves the first crewed Moon landing.
b.a: Ronald D. Moore / Matt Wolpert / Ben Nedivi
